children: Zicix Corp reported fiscal 2026 results showing revenue rose to $730.56K from $70.07K in 2025, while the company recorded a net loss of ($1.39M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.19) for the year — according to its 10-K filing for the period ended 2026.
¹ Reported as “Revenues, net”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by a recent acquisition and new business lines as the company shifted away from its previously suspended Hong Kong logistics platform.
Zicix transitioned toward AI-enabled marketing and advertising services and expanded sales of 3D LED displays and LED components.
Management cited expansion into Hong Kong/China media customers and plans to establish a Dubai hub targeting Middle East growth by the end of 2026.
Operational milestones included launching cloud consulting services and beginning sales of product lines such as LED components and air cargo pallets following the acquisition.
